name: Two-Level Grid Construction
aliases: Two-Level Grid Construction — Two-Level Grids for Ray Tracing on GPUs construction
Two-Level Grids for Ray Tracing on GPUs construction
definition: A construction algorithm for two-level acceleration structures that uses radix sort to build top-level and leaf-level grids efficiently on GPUs, solving the problem of fast, linear-complexity build times for large scenes.
summary: Two-Level Grid Construction is a massively parallel, sort-based algorithm that builds hierarchical acceleration structures for ray tracing by adapting resolution per top-level cell to handle non-uniform primitive distributions efficiently.
